name: Versatile Polymorph
body:
You are able to take on even more alternate forms.

Prerequisite(s): Shifter training class feature.

Benefit(s): You may use your shifter shape ability to assume one of the following forms (your choice): elemental (as elemental body IV), object (as object form III), or undead (as undead anatomy IV).

Special: You may select this feat more than once. Each time you must choose a different form to assume.

Special: This feat is for the Polymorph Savant prestige class from Legendary Shifters.
